[![Tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tests-none_to_validate-lightgrey?logo=go)](https://go2cs.net/ValidatedTestPackages.html) [![Docs](https://img.shields.io/badge/Docs-@v0.23.1--0.20240603234054--0b431c7de36a-00ADD8?logo=go)](https://pkg.go.dev/golang.org/x/crypto@v0.23.1-0.20240603234054-0b431c7de36a/hkdf)

Package hkdf implements the HMAC-based Extract-and-Expand Key Derivation Function (HKDF) as defined in RFC 5869.

HKDF is a cryptographic key derivation function (KDF) with the goal of expanding limited input keying material into one or more cryptographically strong secret keys.
